command.help:
**How Optimus works**
Every posted image is hashed and compared against this server's blocklist (and, if opted in, the shared global scam list). Matches either act automatically or land as a review card in your review channel, depending on `action_policy`. Global matches ALWAYS come as review cards — the shared list never bans or deletes on its own.

**Commands**
• `/setup` — create or link the private review channel (start here)
• `/scamhash add|remove|list|review|import|export` — manage this server's blocklist; `review` marks a posted message as scam by link/ID
• `/config view|set` — every setting, each explained inline
• `/stats` — detection activity and database health
• `/report` — any member can send a scam image to the mods by link/ID (same as right-click → Apps → Report scam to mods)
• `/delete_server_data` — admin-only full wipe (GDPR)

**Review card buttons**
Confirm scam · False positive · Ban uploader · Unban · Whitelist image — one press each, logged to the audit trail. On servers approved for global contribution, *Confirm scam* also casts this server's vote toward the shared scam list, and *False positive* revokes a bad global entry for everyone.

Full guide: <https://github.com/rafs2006/optimus/blob/main/docs/moderator-guide.md>
Privacy policy: <https://github.com/rafs2006/optimus/blob/main/docs/privacy-policy.md>

config_help.sensitivity: How close an image must be to a known scam to match: lenient = near-exact only, strict = catches more edits but risks more false positives. Default: balanced.
config_help.action_policy: What happens on a confident match: none = log only, report_only = post a review card, delete = also delete the message, delete_ban = also ban the uploader. Default: report_only.
config_help.mod_queue_threshold: Matches with confidence below this number (0–1) go to the review channel instead of auto-action. Default: 0.5.
config_help.review_channel: Where review cards are posted. Set it with /setup. Default: not set (cards cannot be delivered).
config_help.ban_purge_hours: When a ban is issued, how many hours of the user's recent messages to purge (max 168). Default: 24.
config_help.safe_mode: true pauses all automatic enforcement (report-only) — useful right after setup or during an incident. Default: false.
config_help.retention_days: How long detection records are kept before automatic deletion. Default: 30.
config_help.locale: Language for replies and review cards (en, sr). Default: en.
config_help.optin_global_db: true checks images against the shared cross-server scam list. Global matches only ever create review cards — they never auto-delete or auto-ban. Default: false.
config_help.optin_scan_bots: true also scans images posted by other bots and webhooks. Default: false.
config_help.optin_evidence_storage: true stores an encrypted copy of flagged images so review cards still show evidence after Discord deletes the original. Default: false.

failure.system_message: Discord system messages cannot be deleted.
failure.ban_limit: this server reached Discord's limit on banning users who are not members. Try again later.
failure.dm_blocked: the user has DMs closed. No action is needed.
failure.rate_limited: Discord is rate limiting the bot. It will be retried automatically.
failure.circuit_open: Discord was refusing requests, so the bot paused to avoid making it worse. It resumes automatically.
failure.duplicate: this action already ran for that message.
failure.transient: Discord returned a server error. It will be retried automatically.
failure.unknown: Discord returned an unexpected error. If it keeps happening, report it with the detection id above.
